meaning: Every repo Linguist tags as containing PHP, including those where PHP is a minor part of the codebase
Declares its own manifest somewhere outside vendor/, the project participates in the Composer ecosystem
No manifest of its own anywhere in the tree
The conventional layout: composer.json sits next to the README
Manifest lives in a subdirectory. Deliberate in monorepos, accidental in projects whose PHP code is buried under src/, api/ or web/
Dependencies checked into version control instead of being installed from the lock file
Dependencies committed without the file that describes them, these repos use the ecosystem but are invisible to any manifest-based search
